name: squibl
description: Squibl monorepo — Next.js frontend, Express API, Expo mobile, and shared packages

scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@squibl/database && npm run build --workspace=@squibl/constants && npm run build --workspace=@squibl/types && npm run build --workspace=@squibl/validation
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.clean: rimraf frontend/.next backend/dist packages/*/dist node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules
